verdict.rationale: Elastic's own marketing page says users can 'interact directly with your telemetry through natural language,' and mentions an AI SRE that investigates incidents. This is first-party support for natural-language interaction, but it is a single high-level claim focused on querying telemetry, not on operating the product broadly. Missing for 10: documentation of natural-language commands for operating the product (e.g., creating rules, SLOs, cases or configuration), detailed first-party docs on the natural-language interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
